scope: Exact c386 source/config scheduling and thread propagation only; no board or model execution and no patches.

active_process_thread_chain.description: Production GUI creates the persistent BoardProcessSpeechGate child before recording; config selects combined frontend_process and frontend_capture_process. Child launch has dedicated environment OMP_NUM_THREADS/OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS/MKL_NUM_THREADS=1.

_worker_main priority() calls setpriority(PRIO_PROCESS,0,-10), checks it, then serve_shared applies this callback BEFORE gate_factory creates GTCRN/VAD. PRIO_PROCESS0 is the caller target here; this is a separate child, not a call that renices all existing GUI threads.

Production recording_options first chooses priority options then automatic_capture_recording_options replaces auto_capture_factory with RemoteAutomaticCapture. In the worker, ChildAutomaticSession defaults to original BoardAutomaticCapture with owned_arecord_factory. The active automatic path does not instantiate PriorityBoardAutomaticCapture in GUI.

ChildAutomaticSession.start invokes capture.start from the already-prioritized frontend main. Capture.start starts owned arecord before creating aura-mcp01-capture reader. owned_arecord_factory uses Python parent-death wrapper then exec arecord; no nice reset appears in that wrapper. Priority inheritance to these later children/threads is a source-based expectation that needs real per-TID evidence.

BoardAutomaticCapture MRO contains BoundedPcmCaptureMixin. Its reader creates aura-board-raw-pcm pump; the existing consumer calls endpoint.feed and the leased gate on that consumer thread. Thus automatic GTCRN/VAD compute belongs to the frontend child capture consumer, not necessarily its main RPC thread.

RemoteAutomaticCapture starts aura-automatic-control-poll in the GUI process, default poll_interval .05s. It exchanges/installs capture status; model compute is in the child. No nice change is performed by this poll class. Actual inherited GUI TID policy/nice remains to be read.

thread_and_library_limits.description: Process constructor enforces num_threads exactly1. Combined worker passes1 through ReuseFftSpeechGate to original FFT denoiser ORT SessionOptions. This is not proof that the OS process has only one TID; transport/consumer/pump/timer/library helpers are additional. No execution_mode override or explicit spinning policy is set in this GTCRN constructor.

Same combined frontend sets Sherpa VadModelConfig.num_threads=1 and sample_rate16000. GTCRN and VAD are called within the single leased capture path; do not count their settings as two always-running parallel inference cores.
Applied only to the child Popen environment, before its model creation. It does not rewrite the GUI parent environment or establish actual runtime thread state.

Current config selects Paraformer small with2 threads, forwarded to CPU sherpa recognizer. ABA has no pending business jobs; the source does not place ASR inference on the continuous pre-speech recording path. Do not change these2 threads based on this recording-only ABA.

Production speaker constructor passes threads1 and .35/.1/.6 policy; exact current encoder uses NumPy features and ORT, not Torch. ABA speaker active/queued is0. No ECAPA/model/policy modification follows from this scheduling review.

No torch import/thread API appears in the active combined GTCRN/VAD chain. The exact41-source scan finds torch.set_num_threads(4) only in local selected/OmniVoice TTS implementations; ABA has no playing/pending, so that fact does not attribute this recording-only change to Torch.

priority_scope_findings.finding: The active process frontend unconditionally requests nice -10 before model initialization and capture creation. Its scope includes the GTCRN/VAD execution context and later capture infrastructure by creation/inheritance; it is not limited to arecord or a raw PCM mover.
priority_scope_findings.why_relevant: When recording runs, high-priority model/capture work can compete with GTK/camera on inherited allowed CPUs. OFF can remove runnable audio work while leaving the same high-priority worker idle. This is compatible with the ABA runqueue/display changes but source alone does not prove actual scheduler allocation or total oversubscription.

priority_scope_findings.finding: capture_priority_nice controls the GUI local priority factory choice, while BoardProcessSpeechGate has no priority parameter and hardcodes -10. With frontend_capture_process=true the remote automatic factory replaces the local priority auto factory. Changing only the capture_priority_nice field would not disable the worker priority request.

PriorityBoardAutomaticCapture explicitly targets get_native_id(), restores the same TID in finally, and describes only consumer+pump scope with arecord already launched at original priority. Those claims belong to the local mixin; they do not establish the active process frontend priority scope.

BoardProcessSpeechGate.public emits worker_nice=-10 as a literal. _accept verifies returned worker nice at protocol replies, but this is not a fresh dump of every consumer/pump/library TID. _accept rejects a worker reply with nice other than -10, so a blind external renice would also conflict with the existing transport contract.

oversubscription_assessment.description: The source has explicit small model limits, plus several IO/control/consumer threads/processes. It does not establish how many are runnable at once or their live affinity/policy. No sched_setscheduler/SCHED_FIFO/SCHED_RR/chrt/sched_setaffinity call was found in the exact41 audio-source scan. Existing systemd/inherited policy or cgroup cpusets remain unmeasured.

aba_evidence.interpretation: Recording ON/OFF/ON corresponds to repeatable higher GUI main runqueue wait and lower display counter progress, while camera CPU rises when audio is OFF. This supports audio-resource contention as a candidate mechanism without locating a specific busy TID. Constant sampled frequency does not provide missing thermal data. Header freshness does not measure physical scanout or pixel validity.

minimum_live_fields_for_root_existing_2s: Map exact frontend child TGID and birth/cmd owner, its arecord child, GTK and camera TGIDs; do not infer by a loose python process name.
For every task/TID in those exact processes: stat state, utime/stime deltas, priority/nice, policy/rt_priority, last CPU and number of threads; schedstat run-time and runqueue-wait deltas.

Read Cpus_allowed_list for GTK main/pixel workers, frontend main/consumer/pump, camera workers and arecord; record cgroup/cpuset membership only as bounded technical metadata. No affinity is set in the audio sources, so inheritance needs confirmation.
Separate frontend child main RPC TID from its aura-mcp01-capture consumer and raw PCM pump. Python logical thread names may not equal Linux comm; do not attribute compute only from main-TID counters.
Confirm active load on the configured nice -10 TIDs and competing GTK/camera priorities. A process thread count alone is not active inference concurrency or proof of spinning.

If an already authorized projection exposes input_queue capacity/overrun, endpoint_feed cpu/wall totals, frontend worker PID and mode, use these existing metadata counters; preserve unknown when absent. Never export PCM, names, transcripts, keys or vectors.
limitations: No real /proc scheduling or model execution was performed here. All priority inheritance and CPU-contention explanations are source-based mechanisms pending root actual2s owner/TID evidence; this report is not authorization to renice or deploy.

root_reported_current_on_cpu.scope: Numbers reported by root from PROC_CURRENT_ON_1; underlying process-window artifact not read by this subagent, per-TID data is still pending.

actual_hot_process_evidence.interpretation: The additional nearly-one-core process is confirmed as the actual frontend child, separate from GTK and camera. This supports a real continuous-recording compute hotspot. It does not yet prove which of its3 TIDs is hot, which TIDs have -10, whole-machine saturation, or the benefit of changing nice.

wire_thread_proof: Actual _worker_main synchronously runs serve_shared on frontend IPC main. Its result() reads priority_reader() on that sending thread and passes the real value into wire._result. HELLO/init errors, RESET/VAD/FRAME/GATE_RELEASE/STOP and non-AUTO protocol replies are generated there.

Parent _rpc uses decoder(data) when a decoder is supplied; otherwise _accept validates binary RESULT and requires nice=-10. AUTO_START/POLL/CANCEL/CLOSE supply decode_status; AUTO_TAKE supplies decode_take. AUTO replies are JSON/status or take framing, not wire._result, and those decoders have no -10 assertion.

The active AUTO capture consumer is a separate TID that calls GTCRN/VAD through endpoint.feed. Keeping IPC main -10 while that same consumer is0 preserves truthful binary main-thread nice receipts; no protocol constant/check needs changing.
YES_conditions: Only the current frontend worker and active AUTO capture path; exact worker PID/birth/cmd/startup and exact hot non-main TID/birth must be fresh. Snapshot442549/birth3339743 is evidence, not a perpetual target.

Pin the same capture/generation internally, with stable RECORDING/WAITING_SPEECH, no speech-start/result/playback/pending job and unchanged thread set throughout the short trial. Current saved TID receipt omits capture token/generation, so it alone is insufficient for that execution-time gate.

Only that existing hot consumer nice changes -10->0->-10. Main394769, existing pump442550, arecord, GUI, camera, scheduler class, affinity and model settings remain untouched. Fresh readback must verify each intended value and all untouched peer TIDs.

Restoration privilege must be available. Before every priority write recheck worker and task birth; immediately recheck after. Linux setpriority by numeric TID has no birth-CAS, so these checks narrow but cannot eliminate an exit/reuse race. Do not run a plan that cannot tolerate that remaining race.
NO_or_abort_conditions: Hot TID exited, moved to another owner, birth changed, worker restarted, capture ended/canceled/READY/rearmed or changed to non-AUTO/FRAME computation. Never chase a replacement TID or reuse the old number as rollback target.

New capture/timer/library TID appears or speech starts: a thread created by consumer while it is0 may inherit0. Existing pump/arecord do not change with consumer, but later descendants can confound isolation.

Any queue overflow, endpoint/control timeout, capture error, model-owner/state change, playback/job activity, failed nice readback or inability to restore the same live TID. Stop the trial; retain original error/evidence rather than clearing or restarting.
Changing IPC main to0 would make later binary nice receipts fail _accept. Changing all frontend TIDs, process-level blanket renice, FIFO/RR policy or affinity is outside this single-consumer trial.
single_hot_TID_trial_boundary.end_cancel_rebuild: The current child capture uses original BoardAutomaticCapture, not the local CaptureThreadPriority restoring mixin. After a natural close/cancel its consumer/pump are retired; a later capture creates new threads from the unchanged -10 IPC main. If the old TID is gone, do not issue a cleanup setpriority to that numeric TID. Mark the trial aborted and reconcile; do not create/restart a capture to restore it.
forbidden_actions: No change to wire._result, priority_reader, _accept or AUTO decoder, and no fake -10 receipt.
No new candidate, model benchmark or model/thread-count/weights/ECAPA/.35/Native/control25 change.
No silence/PCM/drop/ACK/endpoint changes, no service/capture restart or kill to force a clean sample.
This review performs no renice or board call.
